jub.evidence_english: Artist of the SP ballet troupe, corps de ballet dancer from 16 May 1882; son of the well-known ballet composer C. Pugni.
jub.notes: THIS is the Pugni of the inventory: the dancer son, not the composer Cesare Pugni. Printed patronymic is Цезаревичъ (the season review's «Н. П. Пуни» initials do not match this printing — check the review reading). Died of chronic pulmonary tuberculosis in the Palace Department hospital; buried Mitrofan'evskoe.
